title: GDPR, AI Act and ISO 27001 as Pillars of Corporate Accountability for Personal Data in AI Systems - search protocol and data
description: Replication package for a structured literature review (Scopus and Web of Science, searched 8-9 November 2026) on corporate accountability for personal data in AI systems under the GDPR, the AI Act, NIS2 and ISO/IEC 27001. Contains the full Boolean search strings, record counts, the screening record, the list of 22 included studies with DOIs, and data and code for Figures 1 and 2. The manuscript is not included.
